description: This Java source file defines the VerticalFlowLayout class, a custom layout manager for arranging components vertically with specific alignment options. It includes methods for layout calculations, component positioning, and serialization support.

classes.name: VerticalFlowLayout
classes.description: A custom layout manager for arranging components vertically with configurable alignment, gaps, and serialization support.

methods.name: setMaximizeOtherDimension
methods.description: Sets whether to maximize the other dimension of components during layout.

methods.name: isMaximizeOtherDimension
methods.description: Returns whether the layout maximizes the other dimension of components.

methods.name: getAlignment
methods.description: Retrieves the current alignment setting for component rows.

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: Sets the alignment for component rows (top, center, bottom, leading, trailing).

methods.name: getHgap
methods.description: Gets the horizontal gap between components.

methods.name: setHgap
methods.description: Sets the horizontal gap between components.

methods.name: getVgap
methods.description: Gets the vertical gap between components.

methods.name: setVgap
methods.description: Sets the vertical gap between components.

methods.name: addLayoutComponent
methods.description: Placeholder method for adding components; not used.

methods.name: removeLayoutComponent
methods.description: Placeholder method for removing components; not used.

methods.name: preferredLayoutSize
methods.description: Calculates the preferred size of the container based on visible components.

methods.name: minimumLayoutSize
methods.description: Calculates the minimum size needed for the container.

methods.name: moveComponents
methods.description: Centers components within a row based on alignment.

methods.name: layoutContainer
methods.description: Performs the layout of components within the container, arranging them vertically with specified gaps and alignment.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the layout manager and its configuration.
